adjudication.rationale: In the new `Discourse.Group.findMembers()` implementation, the `Discourse.ajax(...).then(...)` promise chain has no rejection handling. This becomes a concrete problem in this diff because callers now frequently invoke it without attaching handlers (e.g. `admin_group_route.js setupController: model.findMembers();` and `group-members.js.es6 setupController: model.findMembers();`). If the AJAX call fails (4xx/5xx/network), the rejection can go unhandled and the model properties (`members`, `user_count`, etc.) remain at their previous values, with no error propagation to the route/controller.
